articles.title: Power struggle erupts at Ondo Finance after founder’s death
articles.snippet: Three Delaware court filings reveal a battle for control of Ondo Finance after founder Nathan Allman's death.

articles.title: Crypto firm RedotPay says it will defend itself ‘vigorously’ against Binance lawsuit
articles.snippet: Binance alleged RedotPay poached customers from the crypto exchange in a lawsuit filed in Hong Kong.

articles.title: Bitcoin AI Security Audit Files 4,962 Findings Across 390 Projects
articles.snippet: A volunteer group is pointing AI agents at Bitcoin project codebases and says 720 of the issues it has filed are high severity or critical.
